order: Count owner0/owner1 stores in source order array up to first-1 (max10).
Inspect rivals in that order for withdrawal; after first withdrawal return immediately.
If no rivals remain: force rival cash0 and return.
Draw RNG once, continue only if low2 bits zero.
Find first inactive slot; initialize candidate (it remains inactive until successful activation).
Select1..3 staff, tier, built-in layout, permits, site and costs.
If any prerequisite fails return with partial candidate data retained.
On success post costs, initialize hours/product settings, bind staff, increment serial, activate town footprint, rebuild masks/cache and notify.

withdrawal.profit: Previous-month five signed32 ledger fields+0xd4c; revenue field+16 minus first4 costs with signed32 arithmetic.
withdrawal.streak: If profit<0 increment unsigned16+0x1184; otherwise set0, including exactly0 profit. Later threshold compares that field as signed16>=6.
withdrawal.normal: Withdraw at signed streak>=6 except serial1 is protected while rival count>=2.
withdrawal.exception: Serial1 AND own count==9 AND month==1 withdraws regardless of profit/streak, including otherwise protected case.
withdrawal.refund: Post negative land value and negative premises mode0 value via1CBC4; premises value=(trunc(tier/2)+1)*3m + equipment + remaining procurement-valued stock.
withdrawal.staff: Unbind assigned staff and close town footprint using source close helper.
withdrawal.last_rival: Force rival company cash to0 even after refund posting; emit final withdrawal notification.
withdrawal.notification: Per-store sound28, final sound100 mapped by event consumer. One store withdrawal per manager invocation.

opening.gate: RNG output&3==0, conditional on rival presence/no withdrawal. This is not an unconditional monthly25% opening probability.
opening.staff: Draw count RNG%3+1. For each slot draw start RNG%35, circularly scan35 records for owner word0 and not already selected. Nonzero ownership, including0xffff, blocks selection. No partial opening when insufficient people.
opening.tier: signed8 control0x800cd994<3: RNG%2; <6:RNG%4; otherwise RNG%6. Initial loader fills this control from total active source count; no assumption every later writer is recovered here.
opening.layout: mode=signed8 header/control0x800cd8a8+3; native loader row=tier*5+mode-1. Original TOWN headers0/1/2 select variants2/3/4.
opening.permit: Inspect product images in loaded layout; product8 tobacco=>C74,2 alcohol=>C75,22 drug=>C76. Required fees3m/7m/10m. Site mask8 plus4/2/1 respectively.
opening.site: Start x=RNG%59,y=RNG%49. Wrap search y over0..48, x over0..58 (reset x start each row), first suitable2x2. Only top-left signed land coefficient must>=8; all four cells must have zero intersection with site mask.
opening.cost: land + trunc(full demolition/2) + construction6m*(trunc(tier/2)+1) + required permit fees + equipment + inventory. Signed32 sum. Cash equality accepted (reject only total>rival cash).
opening.ledger: Capital: land,half demolition,construction,permits,inventory. Procurement store+D94:equipment. Preserve original caller posting, not player purchase assumptions.
opening.hours: RNG%6 selects schedule0..5, including24時間; schedule6臨時休業 excluded.
opening.product_settings: 27 initial settings from original product master. For each product, RNG&15==0 triggers another RNG%7*5 discount candidate0..30; apply only if candidate<current setting.
opening.successful_activation: Increment rival u16 serial0x800cd9e2; bind selected staff; place rival town tile; rebuild flags/cache; queue sound101.
opening.failure: Candidate slot may retain initialized record, staff references and loaded layout; no active byte means no opened store. Do not infer opening from stale return value.

existing_remodel_scope: This recovered monthly-manager path opens/closes stores; no existing-store remodel operation is identified inside this function. Other game systems are not ruled out.

New source-data links bind18 actual layout/permit/cost/posting variants to4 headers/72 map-layout rows,11 withdrawal asset values,140 first-free staff starts and27 initial price tables. No new month gameplay runs.
limits: All source initial maps have land coefficient5, so all source site counts are0 for this>=8 rule. This is not a proof rivals never expand later.
Withdrawal refunds are static asset valuations, not naturally realized withdrawals.
Staff circular start counts are data mappings, not measured LCG sampling probabilities.
